title: Gum recession surgery
what: The doctor covers the exposed tooth root with a small piece of your own tissue, usually from the roof of your mouth, or with a special material.
why: When the gum has pulled back and the root is exposed: the tooth is sensitive, it looks uneven, or the gum keeps receding.
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners - your doctor will tell you what to stop and when

prepare.title: Cleaning
prepare.text: A professional teeth cleaning is usually done before the surgery.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat 1 to 2 hours before the surgery.

bring: Tooth scans, if you have them
steps: The doctor prepares the area around the exposed root
Takes a thin piece of tissue from the roof of your mouth, or uses a material
Sometimes a protective plate is placed on the roof of your mouth
feel: Under numbing you feel pressure but no pain
Afterwards both the roof of your mouth and the gum hurt - you are given a painkiller
Swelling and slight bruising for a few days
after: Do not chew on this side until your doctor allows it
Soft, cool food for a few days
Do not touch the stitches with your tongue or pull your lip away
Do not brush the surgery area until you are allowed
Stitches are usually removed after 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: Bleeding from the roof of your mouth or the gum does not stop when you press on it

faq.q: Why take tissue from the roof of the mouth?
faq.a: Your own tissue takes well. The roof of the mouth heals by itself in 1 to 2 weeks.
It can, if the causes remain: hard brushing or gum disease. Your doctor will tell you how to protect it.

reminders.text: Gum surgery tomorrow. No alcohol. Eat 1 to 2 hours before your visit. Medicines: as your doctor told you.
